description: This family home is close to all sites and amenities (Bon Marché/Invalides/Metro)Located in the heart of central Paris in the oldest building in the 7th arrondissement (exposed beams/parquet floors/etc.)The apartment is located in a four-story mansion with a typical French cheese shop on the ground floor.Accommodation on two floors (100 m2) very bright (triple exposure) Ideal for familiesThe spaceThe accommodation is composed of two floorsOn the 4th floorA room with a large double bed A bedroom with a sofa bedOne Bedroom with 2 children's beds (3 to 6 years)Bathroom with bath and separate shower Independent toiletOn the 3rd floorA living room with a large library and a corner sofaA dining roomA large equipped kitchenGuest accessThe entire independent duplex accommodation on the 3 and 4 floors ( the last two of the mansion)Other things to noteAtypical accommodation located in the heart of Paris in a mansion with one of the most beautiful cheese shops in Paris on the ground floor. (Visit and tasting possible upon request)
